# FLX-3501: a sink needs an optional extra that is not installed

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The engine's core installs without any columnar or database library, so the sinks that need one live behind optional extras: the Arrow, Parquet and Arrow IPC sinks need pyarrow, from flux-sim-engine[arrow], and the database sink needs adbc-driver-manager, from flux-sim-engine[adbc], plus the ADBC driver for the database. Install the extra the message names, for example pip install 'flux-sim-engine[arrow]', and run the command again. Nothing was written: the check runs before a sink opens.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3501
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
